# lovable.ge - Full-Stack AI Software Development, Vibe Coding & Web Apps in Georgia

> lovable.ge is Georgia's specialized portal and learning center for Lovable AI (Lovable.dev), prompt-driven web app generation ("Vibe Coding"), React/Tailwind frontend scaffolding, Supabase backend integration, and enterprise MVP prototyping, authored and curated by Giorgi Basilaia.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Lovable AI Georgia Hub](https://lovable.ge/): Practical mastery of Lovable.dev, natural language full-stack web application development, and 1-click deployment.
- [Prompt to Production Workflow](https://lovable.ge/): Converting text descriptions and UI mockups into clean, production-grade React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS code.
- [Backend & Database Integration](https://lovable.ge/): Attaching Supabase for PostgreSQL relational data, user authentication (OAuth & Magic Links), and Row Level Security (RLS).
- [Enterprise MVPs & Internal Tools](https://chatgpt.ge/corporate-training.html): Helping Georgian businesses build internal tools, client portals, and operational dashboards in 1 day without software engineering teams.
- [Make.ge & API Automation](https://make.ge/): Connecting Lovable web applications to webhook workflows (Make.com, n8n) and AI agents.

## Lead Instructor & Academic Authority

- **Lead Instructor:** Giorgi Basilaia (Associate Professor at the [Free University of Tbilisi](https://freeuni.edu.ge/ge/details/?person=giorgi-basilaia), IT Director, Google Gemini Certified Educator).
- **Track Record:** 25+ years in IT & software architecture, 14 scientific papers, 3388+ citations on Google Scholar, leader in 18 international research projects (NATO, USAID, ERASMUS).

## Connected AI Ecosystem

- [chatgpt.ge](https://chatgpt.ge): Flagship Generative AI courses and corporate training.
- [make.ge](https://make.ge): No-Code & Enterprise AI Automation course (Make.com, n8n, AI agents, MCP).
- [elevenlabs.ge](https://elevenlabs.ge): Voice AI, Georgian text-to-speech, audio cloning, and voice agents.
- [perplexity.ge](https://perplexity.ge): AI search engines, factual deep research, and enterprise intelligence portal.
- [basilaia.com](https://basilaia.com): Central authority hub and executive advisory by Giorgi Basilaia.
